source: card-pass step 1 fan-out (wf_7973a108, 13 agents, empirical parser checks)

ACROBATICS.name: Acrobatics
ACROBATICS.evidence: Parse: {'draw': 3/4, 'hits': 1}. Draw priced via w_draw; discard rider unmodeled but replanning after the real play corrects the hand.

AGGRESSION.name: Aggression
AGGRESSION.evidence: Parser returned only {'conditional': True}; 'At the start of your turn' matches the per-turn-power zeroing in _to_planned (nothing to zero anyway), so it is played as a zero-immediate power and banked via the w_power_played horizon term — the designed handling for future-stream powers. No within-turn misplay; its retrieval/upgrade value is inherently cross-turn.

ARMAMENTS.name: Armaments
ARMAMENTS.evidence: Parser returned {'block': 5} — block correct, but 'Upgrade a card in your Hand' is invisible (not even conditional-flagged). The sim gives the upgrade zero value and no sequencing preference, so the planner may play Armaments last, after the attacks it could have upgraded; live replanning only captures the upgrade if Armaments happens to go first.
ARMAMENTS.proposal: Rage-style special case in _to_planned: detect 'Upgrade a card/ALL cards in your Hand' and add a small early-sequencing bonus (value scaled by cards remaining in hand for the upgraded version), so it sorts before attacks.

ASHEN_STRIKE.name: Ashen Strike
ASHEN_STRIKE.evidence: Parse: {damage: 6, conditional} — the '+3 per card in your Exhaust Pile' is dropped (the Fiend-Fire regex '(\d+) damage for each card' does NOT match because of the word 'additional', so it is not misrouted, just flat 6). Mid-fight with 5 exhausted it's really 21; the exhaust-archetype payoff card is badly undervalued.
ASHEN_STRIKE.proposal: Planner rule keyed on 'for each card in your Exhaust Pile': damage += per_value * len(exhaust pile from game state) (+ cards exhausted this turn). Keep it distinct from _HAND_EXHAUST_DMG so Fiend Fire's hand-scaling isn't confused with pile-scaling.

ASTRAL_PULSE.name: Astral Pulse
ASTRAL_PULSE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 6/8, 'hits': 1, 'aoe': True} — the word 'twice' is missed, so a 0-cost AoE is priced at HALF its real 12/16 total. The _AOE_TIMES regex (textparse.py:20) only matches digit '(\d+) times'; this is the same class of bug as the Conflagration '4 times' fix. Undervalued exactly in the multi-enemy fights (Soul Fysh x4 wall) where it matters most.
ASTRAL_PULSE.proposal: Extend the hit-count regexes to word numerals: '(?:(\d+) times|twice|thrice)' mapping twice->2, thrice->3, in both _AOE_TIMES and the plain multi-hit pattern.

AUTOMATION.name: Automation
AUTOMATION.evidence: Parse: {'energy_gain': 1, 'recognized': ['energy']} — the 'Every 10 cards you draw' trigger is read as immediate +1 energy, and _apply_card adds fx.energy_gain straight to sim energy (combat.py 519). The per-turn-power gate only checks 'start of'/'each turn'/'every turn' (line 177) so 'Every 10 cards' slips through: the sim thinks base Automation is energy-neutral and the upgrade GAINS 1 energy, letting the DFS pick plan lines with one more energy than reality (replan-per-card contains but does not eliminate the distortion).
AUTOMATION.proposal: Broaden the trigger gate in _to_planned for Powers: also zero immediate fx when the text matches 'every \d+ cards' or 'whenever you' (same zeroing as per_turn_power).

BARRICADE.notes: Owner criteria (2026-07-30, after the 92.5-overdraft catch): not awful but hard to justify over Offering-class engines. Serious downsides the naive eval misses: (1) negative tempo -- 3 energy, unreliably drawn, never active turn 1; (2) only pays if you reliably OUTBLOCK enemies on some turns, and outblocking BOSSES/ELITES is the real test -- banking block on normals saves HP but is relatively moot. Draft bar: needs an energy source + a block-heavy deck/relic package already in hand. The sim's smoothed-dps model overestimates outblocking (spike hits crack persistent block) -- delta clamp guards this until variance modeling lands (ENEMY_PASS).

BASH.name: Bash
BASH.evidence: Parser: {'damage': 8, 'hits': 1, 'vulnerable': 2} (up: 10/3). _apply_attack applies VULN_MULT to later hits and adds card.fx.vulnerable to the target; Artifact resolution in _apply_card handles the debuff. Full coverage.

BATTLE_TRANCE.name: Battle Trance
BATTLE_TRANCE.evidence: Parse: {draw: 3}. The 'cannot draw additional cards this turn' lock is invisible: sim only scores draws (w_draw * state.draws, combat.py:632) with no ordering constraint, so the planner won't prefer sequencing other draw cards BEFORE Battle Trance; in the real game later draws fizzle.
BATTLE_TRANCE.proposal: In _to_planned, flag 'cannot draw additional cards this turn' -> in _apply_card zero fx.draw credit for cards played after the lock, which makes the DFS naturally order draw cards first.

BECKON.name: Beckon
BECKON.evidence: Parser returns {self_hp_cost:6, conditional:True} — a misread (the loss hits only if NOT played) — but _to_planned zeroes self_hp_cost for 'in your hand'+'end of' text (combat.py:171-173), and _HAND_HP_LOSS_RE ('lose (\d+) hp', line 646) registers 6 as stranded_unblockable, added straight to hp_loss past block (line 578). This is exactly the mechanic fixed in commit f71a0e1 after the Soul Fysh losses; playing Beckon is correctly valued as clearing 6 unblockable.

BLOODLETTING.name: Bloodletting
BLOODLETTING.evidence: Parser: {'energy_gain': 2, 'self_hp_cost': 3} (up: energy 3) — the [ironclad_energy_icon.png] tokens parse correctly. _score prices self_hp_cost via the tempo-trade cheap-floor curve (owner-tuned for exactly this card, per the 2026-07-09 comment).

BLOOD_WALL.name: Blood Wall
BLOOD_WALL.evidence: Parse returned {'block': 16, 'self_hp_cost': 2, 'recognized': ['block', 'hp_cost']} (20 block upgraded) — both effects captured. _apply_card adds the block (with dex/frail adjustments) and charges self_damage through the HP-scarcity/tempo curve in _score (lines 582-590), which is exactly the right treatment for a small HP-for-block trade.

BLUDGEON.name: Bludgeon
BLUDGEON.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 32, 'hits': 1} (upgraded 42 parses the same way). Plain single-target attack, fully covered by _apply_attack with strength/weak/vuln modifiers.

BODYGUARD.name: Bodyguard
BODYGUARD.evidence: parse: {} (only hits:1) — 'Summon 5.' matches no regex, and no parser field can express it. The card gives the Necrobinder's companion Osty 5 (7 upgraded) HP: tanking value plus fuel for Unleash's HP-scaled damage. grep of sts2bot/policy/ shows the planner has no player-companion concept at all (summon logic is enemy-side only), so the bot prices this Basic at zero and never summons.
BODYGUARD.proposal: Planner rule: track Osty HP in SimState (seed from combat state), map 'Summon N' to +N Osty HP, and value it as block-equivalent plus Unleash fuel; pair with the UNLEASH fix
BODYGUARD.status: partial-fix (2026-07-12): probe of 40 runs of logged states found NO osty/companion field in the mod's state payload, so the full SimState model is blocked on a mod-fork API addition (TODO filed in the proposal). Shipped approximation: 'Summon N' parses as +N block-equivalent (Bodyguard 5, Pull Aggro 4+7; Invoke's next-turn summon correctly deferred by the trigger strip). Unleash keeps its parsed base 6 without the HP-scaling bonus.

BODY_SLAM.name: Body Slam
BODY_SLAM.evidence: Parse returned {'hits': 1} — damage 0, because 'Deal damage equal to your Block' has no number. The sim already tracks my_block in SimState, so the value exists at play time but no rule wires it in: the planner sees a 1-cost (0-cost upgraded) do-nothing and never plays it, forfeiting free damage in every block-heavy turn.
BODY_SLAM.proposal: In _to_planned, detect 'damage equal to your Block' and set a flag; in _apply_card, before the attack resolves, set atk.fx.damage = state.my_block (mirrors the Fiend-Fire dynamic-damage rewrite at line 452-456).

BOLAS.name: Bolas
BOLAS.evidence: Parse: {damage:3, hits:1} (4 upgraded) — a 0-cost attack priced exactly by its damage; the planner takes it whenever it helps and it costs nothing. 'Return to your Hand next turn' is pure next-turn upside that cannot flip a this-turn decision (only marginal edge: a card-cap turn where the slot should go to a bigger hit — the planner already compares damage per play).

BRAND.name: Brand
BRAND.evidence: Parse: {'strength': 1, 'self_hp_cost': 1, 'conditional': True} — both combat-relevant numbers captured; sim applies strength (combat.py:516) and HP cost (520). The 'Exhaust 1 card' choose-prompt is already handled by standard.py:1079 (picks worst card), and replanning after each play absorbs the hand change.

BREAKTHROUGH.name: Breakthrough
BREAKTHROUGH.evidence: Parse: {damage: 9, aoe: True, self_hp_cost: 1} (upgraded 13) — complete. AoE loop and self_damage accounting both exist in _apply_card/_apply_attack.

BULLY.name: Bully
BULLY.evidence: Parse: {damage: 4, conditional} — the '+2 per Vulnerable on the enemy' scaling is dropped. Planner still plays it (0-cost 4 dmg) but undervalues it and won't prefer sequencing it AFTER applying Vulnerable; with 3 Vuln it's really 10 (upgraded 13).
BULLY.proposal: Planner rule keyed on 'additional damage for each Vulnerable': in _apply_card add per_value * target's current Vulnerable stacks (state already tracks vuln applied this turn), giving correct post-Tremble sequencing.

BURNING_PACT.name: Burning Pact
BURNING_PACT.evidence: Parse: {draw: 2, conditional} (upgraded draw: 3). Chosen exhaust of 1 card is a hand-select handled outside the one-turn sim; replanning after the real play keeps hand state honest, and the player-chosen exhaust picks a card the plan wasn't using. No systematic misplay.
BURNING_PACT.proposal: none (optionally set the exhausted-this-turn flag for Forgotten Ritual/Ashen Strike synergy pricing)

BYRDONIS_EGG.name: Byrdonis Egg
BYRDONIS_EGG.evidence: Parser returns nothing; 'Unplayable' means can_play is False and _to_planned returns None, so it never enters combat plans. Hatching at a Rest Site is a map/rest decision outside the combat planner's scope.

CASCADE.name: Cascade
CASCADE.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1, 'conditional': True}. X-cost resolves to current energy in _to_planned but there is no 'X times' damage text, so the sim sees an all-energy-for-nothing play. Worse than dead: dumping X energy into it avoids the w_energy_waste=-0.5/pt penalty for only -0.35 friction, so the planner WILL play it as an end-of-turn energy sink, triggering draw-pile autoplay it cannot model at all (the prompt's canonical multi-turn example).
CASCADE.proposal: File: draw-pile autoplay needs deck-content reasoning the one-turn planner lacks. Interim safety note worth filing with it: blacklist/zero-value 'Play the top ... of your Draw Pile' cards so they are not played as energy dumps.

CATASTROPHE.name: Catastrophe
CATASTROPHE.evidence: Parser returns only {hits:1, conditional:True} for 'Play 2 random cards from your Draw Pile.' — no priceable fields. The planner treats it as a 2-cost no-op, so it never improves a scored line and is effectively never played (under-valued, not actively harmful). Valuing it requires draw-pile contents and random-autoplay expected value — the same class as Cascade's deck autoplay, explicitly a multi-turn/draw-pile design gap.
CATASTROPHE.proposal: File: needs a draw-pile expected-value model (average priceable fx over remaining pile cards) — out of scope for the one-turn planner. Interim: draft policy could deprioritize it since the combat planner strands it.

CELESTIAL_MIGHT.name: Celestial Might
CELESTIAL_MIGHT.evidence: parse: {'damage':6,'hits':3} (hits:4 upgraded) — multi-hit count captured by _DAMAGE_TIMES; _apply_attack simulates per-hit damage correctly

CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.name: Cloak and Dagger
CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.evidence: Parse: {'block': 6, 'hits': 1} for BOTH base and upgrade — 'Add 1 Shiv/2 Shivs into your Hand' is invisible, so 4 (base) / 8 (upgraded) free 0-cost damage is unpriced and base+ parse identically. Planner may skip it at a lethal cut where the shivs finish the kill.
CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.proposal: Generic regex 'Add (\d+|a) Shivs? into your Hand' -> price as N extra 0-cost hits of 4 damage (Shiv constant), either in textparse as bonus damage or in _to_planned like the Fiend-Fire special case.

CLUMSY.name: Clumsy
CLUMSY.evidence: Parser returns nothing (hits=1 default only), but _to_planned starts with 'if not card.can_play: return None' — unplayable curses never enter the plan. Ethereal is irrelevant since it can't be played.

COLLISION_COURSE.name: Collision Course
COLLISION_COURSE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 11/15, 'hits': 1}. The 'Add a Debris into your Hand' downside is invisible, but a 0-cost 11-damage attack is almost always correct to play regardless, and once Debris lands in the real hand the replan (plus the existing 'in your hand'+'end of' stranded-status handling, if Debris carries such text) sees it.
COLLISION_COURSE.proposal: none (note: verify Debris card text once seen live; if it has an end-of-turn hand penalty the existing stranded-status machinery already covers it)

COLOSSUS.name: Colossus
COLOSSUS.evidence: Parser: {'block': 5} only (up: 8) — the '50% less damage from Vulnerable enemies this turn' clause vanishes entirely (not even conditional-flagged, since the _CONDITIONAL regex misses this phrasing). The sim sees a strictly-worse Defend; the defensive halving needs the incoming tally in _score to scale each attacker's incoming by 0.5 when that enemy has vulnerable > 0.
COLOSSUS.proposal: _to_planned regex for 'receive 50% less damage from Vulnerable enemies this turn' sets a vuln_damage_reduction flag on SimState; _score halves incoming from enemies with vulnerable > 0 when set.

CONFLAGRATION.name: Conflagration
CONFLAGRATION.evidence: Parser returns {'damage': 2, 'hits': 4, 'aoe': True} (hits 5 upgraded) — the _DAMAGE_TIMES regex (textparse.py:19, added for exactly this card per its comment) matches 'to ALL enemies 4 times'.

COSMIC_INDIFFERENCE.name: Cosmic Indifference
COSMIC_INDIFFERENCE.evidence: Parse: {'block': 6/9, 'hits': 1, 'conditional': True}. Block fully priced; the discard-pile-to-draw-top rider is deck manipulation with essentially no same-turn combat effect, so ignoring it is correct for a one-turn planner.

CRESCENT_SPEAR.name: Crescent Spear
CRESCENT_SPEAR.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 8, 'hits': 1} with NO conditional flag — the 'Deals 2/3 additional damage for ALL your cards that have a [star_icon.png] cost' scaling is dropped silently. Real damage = 8 + 2*count(star-cost cards). A regex can capture the per-card bonus but not the count; pricing needs the master deck (player.deck, which the fork exposes).
CRESCENT_SPEAR.proposal: In _to_planned: regex 'Deals (\d+) additional damage for ALL your cards' + '[star_icon' -> damage += N * count of star-cost cards in player.deck. Minimum fallback: make textparse flag 'additional damage for' phrasing as conditional so it stops parsing as clean flat damage.

CRIMSON_MANTLE.name: Crimson Mantle
CRIMSON_MANTLE.evidence: Parse: {'block': 8, 'self_hp_cost': 1, 'conditional': True}, but _to_planned's per_turn_power branch ('start of' matches, line 177-181) zeroes both, and self_damage_power=True (line 182-184, the comment names Crimson Mantle explicitly) so it's banked via power_horizon with the low-HP front-load guard (_score lines 603-607).

CRUELTY.name: Cruelty
CRUELTY.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1} — nothing extracted, not even conditional. It is a Power, does not match the per-turn zeroing ('start of'/'each turn' absent), so it gets generic w_power_played*horizon credit and will be played, but _apply_attack uses a fixed VULN_MULT with no hook for '+25% additional vs Vulnerable' — the sim undercounts all subsequent damage vs vulnerable enemies for the rest of the fight (missed lethals, under-valued vuln application).
CRUELTY.proposal: Planner rule: parse 'Vulnerable enemies take an additional N% damage' into a player-side vuln-multiplier bonus stored in SimState (and read the power from state.player.powers on later turns), applied in _apply_attack alongside VULN_MULT.

DAGGER_THROW.name: Dagger Throw
DAGGER_THROW.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 9/12, 'hits': 1, 'draw': 1}. Damage and draw fully priced; the discard rider self-heals via post-play replanning like Survivor.

DARK_EMBRACE.name: Dark Embrace
DARK_EMBRACE.evidence: Parse: {'draw': 1, 'conditional': True}. The card draws NOTHING when played (draw fires per future exhaust), but per_turn_power in _to_planned only triggers on 'start of'/'each turn'/'every turn' — 'Whenever a card is Exhausted' matches none, so the sim credits an immediate draw of 1 via s.draws (combat.py:518). The real per-exhaust engine value is unpriced; power banking via w_power_played partially compensates.
DARK_EMBRACE.proposal: Add 'whenever' to the per_turn_power trigger list in _to_planned (line 177) and zero fx.draw alongside block/energy/strength there, so whenever-triggered powers are priced purely by the banked power term.

DARK_SHACKLES.name: Dark Shackles
DARK_SHACKLES.evidence: Parse returned only {'conditional': True} — 'Enemy loses 9 Strength this turn' has no fx field at all (textparse only matches 'Gain N Strength' for self, line 34). The planner sees a 0-value card; since it's 0-cost the misprice means it never deliberately plays it to blunt a big multi-hit turn, wasting free flat mitigation (9-15 less per enemy hit).
DARK_SHACKLES.proposal: Add an enemy_strength_down field parsed from r'Enemy loses (\d+) Strength', and in _apply_card reduce the target's incoming by N per parsed intent hit (or conservatively by N flat) for this turn — analogous to the Weak incoming reduction at line 483.

DAZED.name: Dazed
DAZED.evidence: Parse: {hits:1} only. Unplayable → filtered by can_play at combat.py:137. Ethereal (self-exhausts at end of turn) affects no player decision the planner controls. Nothing to misplay.

DEBILITATE.name: Debilitate
DEBILITATE.evidence: parse: {'damage':10,'hits':1} (12 upgraded), no conditional flag — planner plays it as a plain 10-damage attack, which is safe, but the real effect (Vulnerable and Weak twice as effective vs that enemy for 2/3 turns) is invisible: no regex can map 'twice as effective' onto existing fields, and _apply_attack's vuln multiplier has no per-enemy modifier hook. Result is undervaluation and unguided ordering vs Vulnerable appliers, not a catastrophic misplay.
DEBILITATE.proposal: Sim rule: per-enemy vuln/weak effectiveness multiplier in EnemySim, set when this card resolves and read in _apply_attack; low priority

DEBRIS.name: Debris
DEBRIS.evidence: Parse: {hits:1, conditional:True} — no priced effect, so the planner never spends 1 energy on it (a 0-value play never beats the baseline score). Correct this turn; the only missed line is spending spare energy to exhaust it for future draw quality, which is cross-turn by definition.
DEBRIS.proposal: File: 'playable status/curse removal with spare energy' as a multi-turn deck-thinning heuristic (could be a small flat bonus for Exhaust-on-play statuses when energy would otherwise be wasted).

DECAY.name: Decay
DECAY.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1, 'conditional': True}; unplayable so excluded from plans. Its bite IS modeled: the stranded-in-hand scan (combat.py 775-782) keyword-gates on 'in your hand'+'end of' and _HAND_TAKE_DMG_RE picks up 'take 2 damage' → 2 blockable damage joins the incoming pool every turn it sits in hand (always, since it can never be played). Correct.

DEFEND_IRONCLAD.name: Defend
DEFEND_IRONCLAD.evidence: Parser: {'block': 5} (upgraded 8), recognized ['block']. Card is exactly that; _apply_card adds block with Dex/Frail modifiers.

DEFEND_REGENT.name: Defend
DEFEND_REGENT.evidence: parse: {'hits':1,'block':5} / upgraded block 8 — exactly the card's full effect

DEFEND_SILENT.name: Defend
DEFEND_SILENT.evidence: Parse: {'block': 5} / upgraded {'block': 8} — exact match; plain block card fully covered by the sim's block/incoming tally.

DEMON_FORM.name: Demon Form
DEMON_FORM.evidence: Parse: {'strength': 2, 'conditional': True} (3 upgraded), but _to_planned's per_turn_power gate matches 'start of' (combat.py 177-181) and zeroes the immediate strength, banking the card via w_power_played × power_horizon instead — exactly the documented Demon Form special case. No immediate-fx overvalue.

DISMANTLE.name: Dismantle
DISMANTLE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 8, 'hits': 1, 'conditional': True} — the 'If the enemy is Vulnerable, hits twice' doubling is invisible, so against a Vulnerable target the sim prices 8*1.5=12 instead of the real 24 (16 base * 1.5). Parsing alone can't express the condition, but the sim already tracks per-enemy vulnerable (e.vulnerable, _apply_attack line 345), so it's checkable at apply time.
DISMANTLE.proposal: Add a PlannedCard flag (e.g. double_if_vuln, set in _to_planned on regex 'if the enemy is vulnerable.*hits twice') and in _apply_attack double hits when e.vulnerable > 0.

DOMINATE.name: Dominate
DOMINATE.evidence: Parser: {'vulnerable': 1, 'strength': 1, 'conditional': True} — reads a flat 1 Strength, but the card grants 1 Str PER Vulnerable stack on the enemy (after its own application). conditional only affects draft priors (standard.py:751), never combat play, so the sim undervalues it whenever the target has vuln stacks (post-Bash it is really +3-4 Str) and cannot price the Bash-then-Dominate sequencing.
DOMINATE.proposal: Planner rule in _to_planned/_apply_card: regex 'Gain N Strength for each Vulnerable' sets a per_vuln_strength scale; at play time credit strength = N * (target.vulnerable + this card's landed vuln), reading EnemySim.vulnerable like the Fiend Fire hand-scale pattern.

DRAMATIC_ENTRANCE.name: Dramatic Entrance
DRAMATIC_ENTRANCE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 11, 'hits': 1, 'aoe': True, 'conditional': True, 'recognized': ['damage']}. 11 AoE at 0 cost is fully priced; Innate is a draw-order effect (out of one-turn scope) and Exhaust is irrelevant within the turn. The conditional flag only affects the standard-policy draft prior, not the combat planner.

DREDGE.name: Dredge
DREDGE.evidence: Parse returned only {'hits': 1, 'conditional': True} — the 'Put 3 cards from your Discard Pile into your Hand' retrieval is invisible, so the planner prices a 1-cost card at zero and never plays it. Retrieved cards land in HAND and are playable this same turn (and the planner replans after every card, so once played the new hand is picked up correctly); the whole gap is the zero valuation.
DREDGE.proposal: Add a regex in textparse.py: r'Put (\d+) cards? from your Discard Pile into your Hand' -> fx.draw += N (selective retrieval is at least as good as draw). One pattern, no sim change.

DRUM_OF_BATTLE.name: Drum of Battle
DRUM_OF_BATTLE.evidence: Parser returned {'draw': 2, 'energy_gain': 2} (3 upgraded) — but the energy only arrives 'When this card is Exhausted', which playing it does NOT do. combat.py line 519 adds fx.energy_gain directly to sim energy, so the planner sees a 1-cost card that refunds 2: a phantom net +1 energy cantrip, systematically over-played and plans built on energy that never materializes.
DRUM_OF_BATTLE.proposal: Generic clause scoping in textparse: strip or zero effects inside a 'When this card is Exhausted,' / 'When(ever) ...' trigger clause before extracting numbers (set conditional instead). Same fix covers Juggernaut's misread damage.

ENVENOM.name: Envenom
ENVENOM.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1, 'conditional': True}. As a Power it does get generic w_power_played*horizon credit in _score, so it is not stranded — but its real mechanic (1/2 Poison per unblocked attack hit) is unmodeled, and like Rage it must be sequenced BEFORE this turn's attacks to trigger on them; the planner has no such ordering pressure, and poison never enters the scored state.
ENVENOM.proposal: Rage-style special case: flag Envenom with a per-attack-hit poison grant so the DFS prefers playing it before attacks, and score applied poison as delayed damage (poison ticks at the enemy's next turn start). Full poison compounding is multi-turn — take the one-turn slice, file the rest.

EQUILIBRIUM.name: Equilibrium
EQUILIBRIUM.evidence: Parse: {block: 13, recognized: ['block']} (upgraded 16) — played correctly as a 2-cost block card this turn. 'Retain your Hand this turn' is invisible: the planner neither credits the carried-over hand nor knows that leaving good cards unplayed is now free, so it under-values the card and may still dump the hand it just paid to keep.
EQUILIBRIUM.proposal: Retain-hold rule (same family as REAP's keyword): when a played card retains the hand, add a small w_retained_card credit per unplayed card in _score so the search prefers holding playables over w_energy_waste dumping. Full valuation of NEXT turn's hand is multi-turn — take only the hold-credit slice now.

EVIL_EYE.name: Evil Eye
EVIL_EYE.evidence: Parser: {'block': 8, 'conditional': True} (up: 11) — only the unconditional first half. The 'another 8 Block if you have Exhausted a card this turn' needs an exhausted-a-card-this-turn flag in SimState; nothing sets or reads one (only Fiend Fire's hand_exhaust_scale exists). Bot plays it as a plain 8-block Defend and never sequences an exhauster first.
EVIL_EYE.proposal: Add exhausted_this_turn bool to SimState, set by cards whose text says 'Exhaust N card(s)'/'Exhaust your Hand' (and self-Exhaust plays); _to_planned regex 'Gain another N Block if you have Exhausted a card this turn' adds N block when the flag is set at play time.

EXPECT_A_FIGHT.name: Expect a Fight
EXPECT_A_FIGHT.evidence: Parse: {energy_gain: 1, conditional} — the single icon is counted as flat 1 energy. Real effect: energy per Attack in hand. At cost 2 the planner prices it as net -1 energy and will essentially never play it, when with 3+ attacks in hand it is net-positive and enabling. No 'for each Attack in your Hand' rule in combat.py.
EXPECT_A_FIGHT.proposal: _to_planned special case: if text matches 'for each Attack in your Hand', set energy_gain = count of Attack-type cards in hand (planner replans per card so hand is known). Also honor the 'cannot gain additional energy' lock by ordering other energy cards first.

FALLING_STAR.name: Falling Star
FALLING_STAR.evidence: parse: {'damage':8,'hits':1,'vulnerable':1,'weak':1} (12 upgraded) — all three effects captured; planner's debuff_order handles Artifact sequencing

FEED.name: Feed
FEED.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 10, 'hits': 1, 'conditional': True} — the damage/exhaust play is priced correctly, so no combat misplay, but the 'If Fatal, raise your Max HP by 3' payoff is invisible: with two ways to secure a kill the planner never prefers landing Feed as the killing blow, forfeiting permanent Max HP over the run.
FEED.proposal: Small sim rule: flag on-fatal-bonus cards in _to_planned ('if fatal') and add a modest _score credit when that card's attack sets killed=True in _apply_attack, nudging sequencing toward Feed kills.

FEEL_NO_PAIN.name: Feel No Pain
FEEL_NO_PAIN.evidence: Parser returns {'block': 3, 'conditional': True} — read as 3 immediate Block, but the real card grants 0 on play and 3 per exhaust event. The per-turn-power zeroing (combat.py:177) only matches 'start of/each turn/every turn', not 'Whenever', so the phantom immediate block survives into the sim; the actual on-exhaust trigger is never simulated.
FEEL_NO_PAIN.proposal: Generic: for Power cards whose text starts effects with 'Whenever', zero immediate fx (same treatment Rage gets at line 159). Optionally credit 3 Block per exhaust event the sim can see (Exhaust-keyword cards played, Second Wind/Fiend Fire exhausts).

FIEND_FIRE.name: Fiend Fire
FIEND_FIRE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 7, 'hits': 1, 'conditional': True}, and _to_planned sets hand_exhaust_scale=7 via _HAND_EXHAUST_DMG ('7 damage for each card' matches; upgraded '10 damage for each card' also matches). _apply_card (combat.py:452-456) rewrites hits = hand_size - cards_played - 1, the documented Fiend Fire special case. Exhausting the rest of hand is fine because the planner replans after every card.

FIGHT_ME.name: Fight Me!
FIGHT_ME.evidence: Parser returned {'damage': 5, 'hits': 1, 'strength': 3} — 'Deal 5 damage twice' should be hits=2 (10 dmg), so the attack is priced at half its damage. _DAMAGE_TIMES in textparse.py only matches 'N times', not 'twice'. The enemy's +1 Strength is also unpriced (minor next-turn cost, silently dropped).
FIGHT_ME.proposal: Extend the hits regex to accept 'twice'/'thrice' (e.g. r'Deal (\d+) damage (?:to ...)? (twice|thrice|(\d+) times)' mapping twice→2). Optionally subtract a small penalty for 'The enemy gains N Strength', but the hits fix is the load-bearing one.

FINESSE.name: Finesse
FINESSE.evidence: Parse: {block: 4, draw: 1, recognized: ['block','draw']} (upgraded block 7) — both effects captured; _apply_card credits block through dex/frail math and draws through w_draw. Fully priced.

FLAME_BARRIER.name: Flame Barrier
FLAME_BARRIER.evidence: Parse: {damage: 4, block: 12, conditional} — the retaliation clause 'deal 4 damage back' is misread as on-play damage. It is inert in the sim (self-target skill, target_i=None so _apply_card:460-466 never applies it), but the parse is wrong and the thorns value (4 per incoming attack this turn) is unpriced, so the card is valued as plain 12 block.
FLAME_BARRIER.proposal: Exclude retaliation phrasing from the damage regex (negative lookahead on 'damage back' / preceded by 'whenever you are attacked') and route it to a thorns field; optionally price thorns = value * expected incoming hits from intents.

FLASH_OF_STEEL.name: Flash of Steel
FLASH_OF_STEEL.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 5, 'hits': 1, 'draw': 1, 'recognized': ['damage', 'draw']} — both effects captured; 0-cost damage+draw is priced by w_damage and w_draw, and the drawn card enters play via live replanning.

FORGOTTEN_RITUAL.name: Forgotten Ritual
FORGOTTEN_RITUAL.evidence: Base parses {energy_gain: 3} via the icon-run regex, but upgraded 'gain 4[ironclad_energy_icon.png]' parses to NOTHING (_ENERGY_ICON_RUN requires icons directly after 'Gain', textparse.py:30) — an upgraded copy is a dead card to the bot. Also the 'If you Exhausted a card this turn' gate is unmodeled: sim credits energy unconditionally (combat.py:519), so base is misplayed as +2 free energy even with no exhaust.
FORGOTTEN_RITUAL.proposal: Extend the energy-icon regex to 'Gain (\d+)\s*\[...energy...png\]' (multiplier form). Separately gate energy_gain in the sim on an exhausted-this-turn flag (set by 'Exhaust.'-keyword cards and True Grit/Burning Pact plays).

FRANTIC_ESCAPE.name: Frantic Escape
FRANTIC_ESCAPE.evidence: Parse: {hits:1} — nothing priced, so the generic combat planner never wastes energy on it. But it is already handled by a dedicated layer: standard.py _survival_card (lines 215-248) generically matches an enemy death-countdown status ('die'/'eaten' in text) to a playable hand card whose description names that status ('Increase Sandpit by 1' contains 'sandpit') and plays it when the counter is at/below survival_status_threshold; capability.py pads the deadline by _SANDPIT_SLACK=3 for these escapes. The code itself notes optimal timing as a later refinement, but the survival case is covered.

GLITTERSTREAM.name: Glitterstream
GLITTERSTREAM.evidence: parse: {'block':11,'conditional':True} (13 upgraded) — this-turn block fully captured, so the card is PLAYED correctly; the 'Next turn, gain 5 Block' rider is only flagged conditional and never valued, a mild undervaluation the one-turn planner can't price by design
GLITTERSTREAM.proposal: File: next-turn-block credit needs a cross-turn score term (e.g. discounted block carryover); not worth forcing into the one-turn sim

GREED.name: Greed
GREED.evidence: Same as Clumsy: parse output empty, and the can_play gate in _to_planned excludes unplayable curses. Eternal (can't be removed) is a deck-management concern, not a combat-planner one.

GUILTY.name: Guilty
GUILTY.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1} only. Unplayable → card.can_play is False → _to_planned returns None (combat.py 137-138), so it never enters the plan. 'Removed from Deck after 5 combats' has no in-combat effect to model.

HAVOC.name: Havoc
HAVOC.evidence: Parse returned only {'conditional': True}. The effect is deck autoplay of an unseen top card — the same class as Cascade, an explicit D example, and C3 forbids peeking at the draw pile. The planner prices it at 0 and never plays it, which is a safe default (autoplaying a random card can even hurt).
HAVOC.proposal: File: needs a draw-pile expected-value model (average-card EV) or the cross-turn layer; do not force into the one-turn sim.

HEADBUTT.name: Headbutt
HEADBUTT.evidence: Parse returned {'damage': 9} (12 upgraded) — the full this-turn effect. The discard-to-top-of-DRAW-pile rider is a next-turn setup the one-turn planner ignores by design; ignoring it undervalues Headbutt only marginally and never causes a misplay this turn.
HEADBUTT.proposal: none (the draw-pile-stacking upside is multi-turn; file only if a cross-turn layer lands)

HELLRAISER.name: Hellraiser
HELLRAISER.evidence: Parse returns {'hits': 1, 'conditional': True} — no priceable fx. It is a Power, so _to_planned banks it via the generic w_power_played credit (combat.py 605-607); the 'whenever you draw' trigger has no immediate fx to misapply. Its real value = autoplaying every drawn Strike-named card, which scales with Strike density in the deck and future draws — outside a one-turn horizon.
HELLRAISER.proposal: File: scale its power credit by the count of cards whose name contains 'Strike' in player.deck (master deck is in state); generic flat power credit is a passable proxy meanwhile.

HEMOKINESIS.name: Hemokinesis
HEMOKINESIS.evidence: Parser returns {'damage': 15, 'self_hp_cost': 2} (20 damage upgraded) — both effects captured; the sim applies self HP cost and damage directly.

HOWL_FROM_BEYOND.notes: Owner catch (2026-07-30): the replay trigger ('if this is in your Exhaust Pile, play it') needs an exhaust ENABLER FOR ATTACKS -- the card can't cheat itself out, and Second Wind only exhausts non-attacks from hand. Without an enabler (True Grit+-class: choose-a-card exhaust) the replay value is LATENT. Draft synergy: True Grit+ 'would go hard with it'.

IMPERVIOUS.name: Impervious
IMPERVIOUS.evidence: Parser returns {'block': 30, 'conditional': True} (40 upgraded). Block is exact; the Exhaust keyword is irrelevant to a one-turn plan (card is only played once anyway), and the conditional flag only affects the draft prior in standard.py:751, not combat planning.

INFECTION.name: Infection
INFECTION.evidence: Parse: {conditional:True}, but parsing is moot: unplayable cards are filtered at combat.py:137 (if not card.can_play: return None) so the planner never tries to play it. Its 'end of your turn, if this is in your Hand, take 3 damage' matches the stranded-status gate ('in your hand' + 'end of') and _HAND_TAKE_DMG_RE, and the stranded pool loops the FULL hand (combat.py:775-782), so the 3 blockable damage is correctly added to incoming/hp_loss (Toxic-type). Fully handled.

INFLAME.name: Inflame
INFLAME.evidence: Parser returns {'strength': 2} (3 upgraded). No per-turn phrasing, so combat.py:177 leaves it immediate — correct, Inflame's Strength applies instantly and permanently. is_power also banks the power_term bonus.

INJURY.name: Injury
INJURY.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1}. Unplayable with no in-combat effect; _to_planned returns None on can_play=False. Nothing to price.

IRON_WAVE.name: Iron Wave
IRON_WAVE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 5, 'hits': 1, 'block': 5, 'recognized': ['damage', 'block']} — both effects captured; _apply_card applies block (with dex/frail) and _apply_attack the damage. Upgrade (7/7) parses the same way.

JUGGERNAUT.name: Juggernaut
JUGGERNAUT.evidence: Parser returned {'damage': 6, 'conditional': True} — the trigger damage is misread as immediate, but by accident it never lands: powers get targets_enemy=False (target_type != 'AnyEnemy') so target_i is None and _apply_card skips the attack. The real mechanic — 6 dmg to a random enemy per block-gain event — is unsimulated both when playing it and when it is already active, so block cards are undervalued under Juggernaut and there is no play-it-before-block sequencing (mirror of the Rage special case).
JUGGERNAUT.proposal: Rage-mirror special case: a juggernaut_damage field on PlannedCard/SimState that credits N random-enemy damage per block-granting card played after it (and seed it from active combat powers, not just hand). The clause-scoping fix from Drum also cleans up the misparse.

JUGGLING.name: Juggling
JUGGLING.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1} (no fx), and 'each turn' in the text makes per_turn_power=True, so it's banked purely via the power term (w_power_played * power_horizon) — no phantom immediate effects. If the third Attack lands this turn the copied card appears in hand and the replan-after-every-card loop sees it, so within-turn play is correct; its precise attack-density valuation is beyond the one-turn model but the generic power prior is a reasonable price.

LETHALITY.name: Lethality
LETHALITY.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1} — nothing extracted. 'each turn' trips the per_turn_power zeroing in _to_planned (correct direction), so it gets generic w_power_played*horizon credit and gets played, but the sim never applies the +50% (75% upgraded) first-attack multiplier — damage vs its own big hits is undercounted every turn (missed lethals, wrong attack ordering: the biggest attack should go first). Ethereal (exhausts if unplayed) is also unmodeled, so there is no urgency to play it before end of turn.
LETHALITY.proposal: Planner rule: parse 'first Attack each turn deals N% additional damage' into a first-attack multiplier in SimState (also read from active player powers on later turns); apply in _apply_attack to the first attack of the sequence. Ethereal-hold urgency can ride the existing stranded-card machinery as a smaller follow-up.

MANGLE.name: Mangle
MANGLE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 15, 'hits': 1} (upgraded: damage 20) — 'Enemy loses 10 Strength this turn' is silently dropped, not even flagged conditional. The sim does model per-enemy incoming and already mutates it for Weak (combat.py 480-483), but there is no parser field or sim rule for enemy-strength-down, so the planner prices Mangle as a plain 3-cost 15-damage attack and ignores its (often larger) damage-prevention half.
MANGLE.proposal: Add an enemy_strength_down field (regex 'loses (\d+) Strength') and a sim rule in _apply_attack/_enemy state reducing that enemy's incoming by N per hit this turn, parallel to the existing Weak handling.

MAYHEM.name: Mayhem
MAYHEM.evidence: Parse: {conditional:True}, no misread immediates. _to_planned: is_power + per_turn_power=True ('start of' matches) → nothing zeroed by mistake, banked via flat w_power_played x power_horizon, so the planner plays it early — usually the right call. Its real value (autoplay top of draw pile each turn) is deck-composition-dependent and cross-turn: with a status/curse-clogged deck the flat power credit over-values it, and no one-turn rule can price 'what's on top next turn'.
MAYHEM.proposal: File alongside the Cascade deck-autoplay class: condition the power credit on deck quality (fraction of statuses/curses in draw pile) when text says 'play the top card of your Draw Pile'.

MIRAGE.name: Mirage
MIRAGE.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1, 'conditional': True} — zero block. Real block = sum of Poison across ALL enemies. combat.py has no poison tracking anywhere (grep 'poison' = 0 hits), so the planner sees a 1-cost no-op and never plays it even when enemies carry 20+ poison.
MIRAGE.proposal: Sim rule in _to_planned: on 'Block equal to Poison on ALL enemies', set fx.block = sum of POISON stacks read from each enemy's status list (same scan _enemy_sims already does for VULNERABLE/ARTIFACT).

MOLTEN_FIST.name: Molten Fist
MOLTEN_FIST.evidence: Parser: {'damage': 10, 'conditional': True} (up: 14) — 'Double the enemy's Vulnerable' is not represented; the sim plays it as a vanilla 10-damage exhaust attack. Doubling needs the target's live vulnerable count (EnemySim.vulnerable), which parsing alone cannot express, and sequencing after a vuln applier goes unpriced.
MOLTEN_FIST.proposal: Planner rule: _to_planned regex "Double the enemy's Vulnerable" sets a doubles_vuln flag; _apply_card sets target.vulnerable *= 2 after the hit and credits the added stacks to vuln_applied.

NEOWS_FURY.name: Neow's Fury
NEOWS_FURY.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 10, 'hits': 1, 'conditional': True, 'recognized': ['damage']}. The 10 damage (14 upgraded) is priced correctly, so the planner plays it at a fine rate; the discard-retrieval upside is unpriced but not a misplay — the retrieved cards appear in hand and the planner replans after every play, so it uses them. Only a mild undervaluation, no wrong action.
NEOWS_FURY.proposal: none (optionally a small flat bonus for 'from your Discard Pile into your Hand' if drafting ever needs it)

NEUTRALIZE.name: Neutralize
NEUTRALIZE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 3/4, 'hits': 1, 'weak': 1/2}. Real effects exactly. Weak is applied in _apply_attack and scored via w_weak; debuff_order handles Artifact ordering.

NORMALITY.name: Normality
NORMALITY.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1}; unplayable → excluded, fine. But its constraint is invisible: the planner's card-cap detection scans player statuses with regex 'only play (\d+) card' (combat.py 694), which does not match 'cannot play more than 3 cards this turn'. With Normality in hand the DFS plans unconstrained sequences, so the executed 3-card prefix may not be the best 3-card line (e.g. spends plays on cheap chaff before the key block/kill card).
NORMALITY.proposal: Broaden the cap regex to r'(?:only play|play more than) (\d+) card' and also scan unplayable hand-card text (not just player statuses) in case the mod surfaces no status for it.
NORMALITY.status: open (card-cap curse; planner-side, deferred per PLAN 8.4)

NOT_YET.name: Not Yet
NOT_YET.evidence: Parser returned {'heal': 10, 'conditional': True} — heal captured; _apply_card caps it at heal_room (max_hp - hp at turn start) so there is no overheal credit. Exhaust has no one-turn consequence.

OFFERING.notes: Owner (2026-07-30): remains the likely pick over Pact's End even in an exhaust deck -- a SINGLE exhausting energy source (Forgotten Ritual) isn't enough for an endgame deck and may fund other cards; Offering is ITSELF exhaust synergy. The greedy sim under-rates lose-HP-now-for-velocity engines (cap delta read it negative vs act-2 generic) -- known bias, tuning kept conservative per owner: 'we don't want to overcorrect'.

OMNISLICE.name: Omnislice
OMNISLICE.evidence: Parse: {damage: 8, hits: 1, aoe: False} — the 'Damage ALL other enemies equal to the damage dealt' splash is lost because _ALL_ENEMIES is r'\bALL enem' and the intervening 'other' breaks it. A 0-cost 8-to-everyone card is priced as 8-to-one, badly under-valued in multi-enemy fights (exactly where the bot dies).
OMNISLICE.proposal: Change _ALL_ENEMIES to r'\bALL (?:other )?enem' (verified match) so fx.aoe=True; treating it as plain 8-damage AoE is the right one-turn approximation (splash equals damage dealt to the primary).

ONE_TWO_PUNCH.name: One-Two Punch
ONE_TWO_PUNCH.evidence: Parse returned {'hits': 1} — nothing. 'Your next Attack is played an extra time' is a sequencing buff the sim must carry as state (like rage_block_active): the next attack card resolves twice. Planner sees a 1-cost blank and never plays it; when it does hold one, it also can't sequence it before the big attack.
ONE_TWO_PUNCH.proposal: Add a next_attack_replays counter to SimState set by a 'next N Attacks? (is|are) played an extra time' pattern in _to_planned; in _apply_card, when an attack is played and the counter > 0, resolve _apply_attack twice and decrement.

PACTS_END.notes: Owner ruling on the f17 fixture deck (2026-07-30): compelling with a real exhaust package (Second Wind/Molten Fist feeding the pile -> recurring free 17 AoE), but Offering still the LIKELY pick -- close, 'would take both if legal'. Independent nuance: it is good FREE AOE, and if the deck lacked AoE (no Howl/Stomp) there's an argument to take it for coverage alone -- AoE need is deck-relative (card-pass tag material).

PECK.name: Peck
PECK.evidence: Parse: {damage: 2, hits: 3} base and {damage: 2, hits: 4} upgraded — _DAMAGE_TIMES captures the numeric multi-hit exactly; no hidden mechanic.

PERFECTED_STRIKE.name: Perfected Strike
PERFECTED_STRIKE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 6, 'hits': 1, 'recognized': ['damage']} — the '+2 (3 upgraded) additional damage for ALL your cards containing "Strike"' scaling is invisible. With a starter deck's ~5 Strikes plus itself the real hit is ~18+, so the planner prices it at a third of its value and treats it as a bad 2-cost 6-damage attack it should never play. Pure text parsing cannot fix it (needs the master deck count), so it is a planner rule, not a regex.
PERFECTED_STRIKE.proposal: Planner rule: parse 'Deals N additional damage for ALL your cards containing "X"' into (N, keyword); _to_planned counts matching names in the master deck (player.deck — the fork exposes it) and adds N*count to fx.damage.

PILLAGE.name: Pillage
PILLAGE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 6, 'hits': 1} — the 'Draw cards until you draw a non-Attack card' clause is completely missed (no draw, and not even the conditional flag fires since none of textparse's synergy keywords match). It's priced as a vanilla 6-damage attack; replan-after-every-card means the real draws are still picked up in play, so the misplay is just mild under-ranking.
PILLAGE.proposal: Add a textparse pattern for 'draw cards until' setting draw=1 (conservative expected value) plus conditional=True.

POMMEL_STRIKE.name: Pommel Strike
POMMEL_STRIKE.evidence: Parser: {'damage': 9, 'hits': 1, 'draw': 1} (up: 10/2). Damage simulated; draw credited via w_draw, which is the planner's designed treatment of draw.

POOR_SLEEP.name: Poor Sleep
POOR_SLEEP.evidence: Parse returned {'hits': 1} (inert), but that never matters: 'Unplayable' means can_play is false and _to_planned returns None at line 137-138, so the planner correctly never considers it. Retain just means it clogs the hand across turns — no play decision exists to get wrong.

PRIMAL_FORCE.name: Primal Force
PRIMAL_FORCE.evidence: Parse is empty ({hits: 1}) but combat.py already special-cases it: _to_planned sets primal_force on 'transform all attacks' (matches this text), _apply_card sets primal_active, and _apply_attack replaces later attacks with _PRIMAL_ROCK_DAMAGE=16 x1. Replan-after-every-card refreshes the real transformed hand, correcting cost/upgrade drift.
PRIMAL_FORCE.proposal: none (optional polish: Giant Rock+ from the upgraded card does more than the constant 16, and sim keeps original card costs until replan — both self-correct on replan)

PRODUCTION.name: Production
PRODUCTION.evidence: Parse: {energy_gain: 2, recognized: ['energy']} (upgraded 3) via the _ENERGY_ICON_RUN icon-token path added 2026-06-26. conditional=True fires on 'Exhaust' but fx.conditional is only read in standard.py draft priors, never in combat.py — the planner plays it as 0-cost +2 energy, which is exactly right.

PROLONG.name: Prolong
PROLONG.evidence: parse: {'conditional':True} only — zero priced value. The card's entire effect ('Next turn, gain Block equal to your current Block') is cross-turn: correct play is sequencing it AFTER stacking block on a heavy-block turn, which requires next-turn reasoning the planner lacks by design. Being 0-cost, misplay cost is bounded (worst case it's played at 0 block and exhausted for nothing).
PROLONG.proposal: File with next-turn-block: value = current end-of-turn block discounted into next turn; needs the multi-turn model (MEMORY: combat capability estimate)

PYRE.name: Pyre
PYRE.evidence: Parser returned {'energy_gain': 1, 'conditional': True} (2 upgraded), but _to_planned's per-turn-power branch ('start of'/'each turn' + is_power) zeroes energy_gain exactly for this case — Pyre is literally the named example in the code comment — and value is banked via the power horizon term. Icon-token energy parsing also works (energy_gain scaled with icon count).

RAGE.name: Rage
RAGE.evidence: Already special-cased: _to_planned matches id RAGE, extracts per-attack block via _RAGE_BLOCK and zeroes the immediate block (combat.py:153-159); _apply_card grants rage_block_active per later Attack (:407,416) and scoring nudges sequencing (:636). Upgraded 5-block value is read from the text by the same regex.

RAMPAGE.name: Rampage
RAMPAGE.evidence: Parser returned {'damage': 9, 'hits': 1} — the current-turn play is priced correctly. 'Increase this card's damage by 5 this combat' is cross-turn scaling the one-turn planner cannot value (preferring Rampage over an equal flat attack to grow it). Later-turn accuracy depends on whether the mod's live description reflects the scaled number.
RAMPAGE.proposal: File: (1) verify live whether STS2MCP's card description/damage field updates as Rampage scales — if not, read the numeric damage field instead of text; (2) note per-play scaling as a multi-turn valuation item.

RATTLE.name: Rattle
RATTLE.evidence: Parse: {hits: 1, conditional: True} — the 7 base damage is missed entirely (same 'Osty deals' gap as SNAP; the deals? regex recovers it), and 'Hits an additional time for each other time he has attacked this turn' is Rage-style sequencing the sim can't get from text: hits should be 1 + prior attacks played this turn, so it must be sequenced LAST.
RATTLE.proposal: First apply the deals? regex (B fix recovers 7x1). Then a _to_planned/_apply_card rule like rage_block: detect 'additional time for each other time' and set hits = 1 + count of attack cards already in state.played, so the planner learns to sequence it after other attacks.

REAP.name: Reap
REAP.evidence: Parse: {damage: 27, hits: 1} (upgraded 33) — full combat value captured. 'Retain.' adds no same-turn effect; combat.py has no retain handling but none is needed to play it correctly this turn (unplayed cards simply stay, and the planner doesn't penalize holding).
REAP.proposal: none (the cross-turn 'hold Retain cards instead of dumping energy' optimization is a shared retain-hold nicety, not a misplay)

RELAX.name: Relax
RELAX.evidence: Parse returned {'block': 15, 'draw': 2, 'energy_gain': 2} — but the draw and energy are NEXT turn ('Next turn, draw 2 cards and gain [energy][energy]'). The parser counts them as immediate; _apply_card credits +2 energy and +2 draws to THIS turn's sim (lines 518-519), so the planner plans follow-up cards with energy that never arrives (replanning recovers the real energy but the turn is already misordered) and over-picks Relax. Same failure the per-turn-power zeroing at line 178-181 fixes for Powers, unfixed for skills.
RELAX.proposal: Generic text fix: in textparse (or _to_planned), truncate/zero any effects parsed from text after a 'Next turn,' clause — split the description at 'Next turn' and only parse the prefix.

RUPTURE.name: Rupture
RUPTURE.evidence: Parser returns {'strength': 1, 'conditional': True} — read as 1 immediate Strength, but the real card grants 0 on play and 1 (2 upgraded) per self-HP-loss event on your turn. Like Feel No Pain, 'Whenever' escapes the per-turn-power zeroing at combat.py:177, so the sim buffs this turn's attacks with phantom Strength; the actual trigger (Hemokinesis/Offering played after it) is never credited.
RUPTURE.proposal: Same generic fix as Feel No Pain: zero immediate fx on 'Whenever' trigger powers; optionally credit Strength per self_hp_cost card the sim plays after Rupture (the sim already tracks those plays).

SALVO.name: Salvo
SALVO.evidence: Parse: {damage:12, hits:1} (16 upgraded) — damage priced correctly, so it gets played when it's the best attack. 'Retain your Hand this turn' has zero handling anywhere (grep for 'retain' in sts2bot/policy finds nothing) — its value is next-turn hand quality, which the one-turn planner scores at 0. No this-turn misplay; only undervaluation vs. other 1-cost attacks and no incentive to hold good cards once Salvo is played.
SALVO.proposal: File: retain-hand as a cross-turn value term (e.g. small credit per unplayed card kept when a retain effect is active).

SECOND_WIND.name: Second Wind
SECOND_WIND.evidence: Parser returns {'block': 5, 'conditional': True} — flat 5 Block. Real effect is 5 Block PER non-Attack card exhausted from hand (often 10-20+), and it removes those cards from hand. combat.py's hand-exhaust scaling (_HAND_EXHAUST_DMG, line 32/163) only matches '(\d+) damage for each card', so no scaling rule fires; the card prices as a worse Defend.
SECOND_WIND.proposal: Add a block twin of the Fiend Fire rule: regex r'(\d+) Block for each card' sets a hand_exhaust_block_scale; in _apply_card multiply by count of unplayed non-Attack cards in hand (same hand_size - played bookkeeping as line 455), and drop those cards from the remaining plan pool.

SETUP_STRIKE.name: Setup Strike
SETUP_STRIKE.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 7, 'hits': 1, 'strength': 2, 'recognized': ['damage', 'strength']} — the 'this turn' qualifier is dropped. In-sim application is actually correct (strength boosts later attacks this turn), but _score adds w_strength(=7.0) * strength_gained as if the 2 Str persisted across turns: +14 phantom score every play, biasing it over genuinely better plays (e.g. needed block).
SETUP_STRIKE.proposal: In _to_planned, when a strength grant is qualified by 'this turn', keep fx.strength for the in-sim my_strength application but exclude it from strength_gained (the persistent-value score term). Same pattern covers Flex-type temp buffs.

SHIV.name: Shiv
SHIV.evidence: Parse returned {'damage': 4, 'recognized': ['damage']} (6 upgraded) — full effect. 0-cost attack, Exhaust; _apply_attack handles it like any single-target hit, strength/vuln/weak multipliers included. Nothing hidden.

SHOCKWAVE.name: Shockwave
SHOCKWAVE.evidence: Parse of 'Apply 3 Weak and Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Exhaust.' returns {weak:3, conditional:True} — vulnerable=0 and aoe=False. Two regex gaps confirmed by probes: _VULN (textparse.py:32, '\bApply (\d+) Vulnerable') misses compound phrasing (even 'Apply 3 Weak and 3 Vulnerable' returns weak only), and aoe is gated on fx.damage (textparse.py:87) so apply-only ALL-enemies cards never set it. Net effect in the sim: 3 Weak lands on ONE enemy (untargeted weak → biggest attacker, combat.py:479) and the Vulnerable — the half that multiplies all subsequent damage by 1.5 in _apply_attack (combat.py:345) and earns w_vulnerable credit — is dropped entirely.
SHOCKWAVE.proposal: Parser: add a compound pattern r'Apply (\d+) (?:Weak and Vulnerable|Vulnerable and Weak)' setting both fields to N; set fx.aoe when _ALL_ENEMIES matches even with damage==0 (apply-only cards). Planner follow-up: when fx.aoe, apply weak to all alive enemies' incoming (combat.py:473-484 currently picks one).

SHRUG_IT_OFF.name: Shrug It Off

SPOILS_MAP.name: Spoils Map

STAMPEDE.name: Stampede

STOKE.name: Stoke
STOKE.evidence: Parse: {'hits': 1, 'conditional': True} — no effect extracted. The Fiend-Fire regex '(\d+) damage for each card' does not match (no 'damage'), so no hand-exhaust handling applies. STOKE.proposal: Planner rule: cards whose text starts 'Exhaust your Hand' set a hand-wipe flag in _to_planned; _apply_card marks all unplayed hand indices unplayable for the rest of the sim (same wipe should apply to Fiend Fire). Random-card upside stays unpriced (fine).

STOMP.name: Stomp

Live replanning partially rescues it only if the mod API reports the discounted current cost.
STOMP.proposal: Planner rule in _to_planned/_apply_card: parse 'Costs 1 less ... for each Attack played this turn' into a per-attack cost discount applied against attacks already in state.played during the sim.

STONE_ARMOR.name: Stone Armor

STONE_ARMOR.proposal: Add regex 'Gain (\d+) Plating' → fx.block = N (credits this turn's end-of-turn block) and set conditional; the existing power banking covers the future-turn stream.

STRATAGEM.name: Stratagem

STRIKE_SILENT.name: Strike
STRIKE_SILENT.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 6, 'hits': 1} / upgraded {'damage': 9, 'hits': 1} — exact match to card effect; plain single-target attack fully covered by _apply_attack.

THE_GAMBIT.name: The Gambit

The planner therefore sees a 0-cost 50-block skill and will play it whenever block matters — then any chip damage on a later turn (which this bot takes constantly in Acts 1-2) is instant death. 'conditional' does not discount it; the misplay is playing it at all.
THE_GAMBIT.proposal: In _to_planned, add a self-death-rider gate: if the description matches r'\byou\b.*\bdie\b' (or simply r'\bdie\.?$' on a player card), return None so the card is never planned. Optimal use (guaranteed-full-block combats) needs cross-turn certainty the one-turn planner lacks, so a hard ban is the safe smallest change.
THE_GAMBIT.status: fixed (2026-07-12): fx.self_death_rider set from full text; _to_planned returns None (never played) and _card_score returns -100 (never drafted). Verified 'die' appears in no other card in the 250-card catalog.

THINKING_AHEAD.name: Thinking Ahead

THRASH.name: Thrash

THUNDERCLAP.name: Thunderclap
THUNDERCLAP.evidence: Parse: {'damage': 4, 'hits': 1, 'aoe': True, 'vulnerable': 1} — everything captured. _apply_card loops _apply_attack over all living enemies for AoE (lines 461-464) and each hit lands the vulnerable on that enemy (line 375), with correct STS timing (its own damage is not boosted by the vuln it applies, line 345 reads pre-attack vulnerable). TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.evidence: Parser returns only {hits:1, conditional:True} ('take 5 damage' is not read as a self-cost), but the planner covers it explicitly: plan_combat_turn keyword-gates 'in your hand'+'end of' and _HAND_TAKE_DMG_RE ('take (\d+) damage', combat.py:647) puts 5 into stranded_blockable; _score adds it to the incoming pool (blockable, line 553) unless the card's hand index is played, so the search correctly credits spending 1 energy to clear it. _to_planned zeroes any misread fx (lines 171-173).

TRUE_GRIT.name: True Grit

TWIN_STRIKE.proposal: Extend _DAMAGE_TIMES multiplier alternation to r'(?:(\d+) times|(twice)|(thrice))' mapping twice→2, thrice→3 — verified it matches 'Deal 5 damage twice.' while still matching 'Deal 2 damage 3 times.'

ULTIMATE_DEFEND.name: Ultimate Defend

UNMOVABLE.name: Unmovable
UNMOVABLE.evidence: Parse is empty ({hits: 1}); as a Power with 'each turn' text it hits the per_turn_power path and is banked generically via w_power_played * power_horizon — so it IS played, at a reasonable prior. UNMOVABLE.proposal: modeled 2026-09-04: PlannedCard.grants_unmovable + SimState unmovable_active/baked/previews_doubled/first_block_used; in-plan doubling after the power, halving of later doubled reads, turn-memory 'blocked' seed.

PANACHE.name: Panache
PANACHE.evidence: Parser returned {damage: 10, hits: 1, aoe: True, recognized: ['damage']} for 'Every time you play 5 cards in a single turn, deal 10 damage to ALL enemies.' — the _TRIGGER_SENTENCE strip (textparse.py:53-54) only matches 'Every \d', so 'Every time' slips through and the trigger damage is credited as immediate. _to_planned's per_turn_power tokens ('start of'/'each turn'/'every turn') also miss it, and per-turn zeroing wouldn't zero damage anyway. Planner harness CONFIRMED false lethal: hand [Panache, Defend] vs 10-HP enemy attacking for 20 → 'plan [Panache] score 90.2 LETHAL', Defend skipped. Real card deals nothing until 5 cards are played.
PANACHE.proposal: Extend _TRIGGER_SENTENCE in textparse.py from 'Every \d' to 'Every (\d|time)' (or just 'Every\b') so the whenever-trigger sentence is dropped; Panache then plays as a generic power via power_term, like Hailstorm does.
PANACHE.status: fixed (trigger strip Every , 2026-07-12 — was a harness-confirmed FALSE LETHAL)

INFERNAL_BLADE.name: Infernal Blade
INFERNAL_BLADE.evidence: Parser returns {damage: 8, hits: 1} via the deliberate _RANDOM_ATTACK heuristic (textparse.py:38-43, the 2026-07-09 live-catch fix). But the credit NEVER lands in the sim: IB is a non-targeting Skill, and _apply_card (combat.py:532-540) only applies damage when aoe or target_i is set; the DFS (combat.py:942) only assigns targets when target_type=='AnyEnemy'. Harness confirmed: 0-cost Infernal Blade+ alone in hand vs an attacker → 'no play improves the turn; end turn' — the exact stranding the fix was meant to cure. The existing IB fixes (test_standard_policy.py:1000, 2244) are draft-scorer-side only.
INFERNAL_BLADE.proposal: In _to_planned, set targets_enemy=(card.target_type=='AnyEnemy' or (fx.damage>0 and not fx.aoe)) so credited generator damage picks a target and lands in _apply_attack; alternatively credit hand-generators as fx.draw (target-free) instead of damage.
INFERNAL_BLADE.status: fixed properly (generator damage now targetable; the 07-09 credit never landed)

MIND_BLAST.name: Mind Blast
MIND_BLAST.evidence: Parser returned {hits: 1, conditional: True} — zero damage for 'Deal damage equal to the number of cards in your Draw Pile.' Harness: vs 15-HP enemy with draw_pile=20 (real damage 20 = lethal) it played it only as a reluctant filler ('score -19.4', no LETHAL flag) — the kill is never counted, so it can never be sequenced for lethal or preferred over blocking. State knows draw_pile_count at plan time; _to_planned already takes exhaust_pile for the identical Ashen Strike pattern (_PER_EXHAUST_PILE, combat.py:239).
MIND_BLAST.proposal: Pass draw_pile_count into _to_planned (like exhaust_pile) and add a regex for 'damage equal to the number of cards in your Draw Pile' setting fx.damage to that count.

JACK_OF_ALL_TRADES.name: Jack of All Trades
JACK_OF_ALL_TRADES.evidence: Parser returned {hits: 1, conditional: True} — nothing credited for 'Add 1 random Colorless card into your Hand. Exhaust.' (_RANDOM_ATTACK requires 'random Attack'; this is 'random Colorless card'). Harness confirmed the 0-cost generator is stranded: alone in hand → 'no play improves the turn; end turn' — same pure-friction failure mode as pre-fix Infernal Blade+ (owner live-caught 2026-07-09).
JACK_OF_ALL_TRADES.proposal: Generalize the generator pattern to 'Add N random ... card(s) into your Hand' and credit it as fx.draw += N — a draw credit lands without a target (w_draw in _score), fixing this card and de-stranding Infernal Blade/Discovery-style generators too.

HAILSTORM.name: Hailstorm
HAILSTORM.evidence: Parser returned {hits: 1, conditional: True} — the 'At the end...' sentence is correctly dropped by _TRIGGER_SENTENCE, so no false immediate damage (contrast Panache). Harness: hand [Hailstorm, Defend] → 'plan [Hailstorm > Defend]' — played early as a generic power via power_term, which is the right one-turn behavior. The unpriced part (end-of-turn 6 AoE if you have Frost, every turn) requires Frost-stack tracking that combat.py doesn't model at all (grep for 'frost' in combat.py: zero hits) plus cross-turn value.
HAILSTORM.proposal: File: pricing needs a Frost resource model in SimState (stacks granted by other cards this turn) plus an end-of-turn conditional AoE tick; until Frost exists in the sim there is nothing to hook. Current generic-power handling is a safe fallback.

METAMORPHOSIS.name: Metamorphosis
METAMORPHOSIS.evidence: Parser returned {hits: 1, conditional: True} — nothing credited ('into your Draw Pile' doesn't match the hand-generator regexes, correctly: the attacks arrive on future draws). Harness: with spare energy vs a non-attacker it still got played ('plan [Metamorphosis] score -0.8'), which is roughly right by accident; but its real value (3-5 free Attacks seeded into future draws) is pure cross-turn draw-pile reasoning the one-turn planner lacks by design.
METAMORPHOSIS.proposal: File as multi-turn: crediting draw-pile seeding needs a next-turn value model. Event rarity keeps exposure minimal; current behavior (plays it when energy is otherwise wasted) is acceptable.

ENTHRALLED.name: Enthralled
ENTHRALLED.text: If this is in your Hand, it must be played before other cards. Eternal.
ENTHRALLED.ruling: Curse. While it sits in hand the game marks every other card can_play=False; playing it (cost 2, no effect) unlocks the hand. Live 2026-09-30: the planner saw no value in it and ended four turns in a row at 4..16 energy (run 20260930-040833, Devoted Sculptor Ritual ramp to 48); era 42 stalled turns in 69 runs.
ENTHRALLED.modeled: plan_combat_turn short-circuit: a playable, affordable 'must be played before other cards' card is played first, unconditionally (2026-09-30).
